tools.name: crowd_call
tools.description: What BitPredict members called on a coin over the last 30 days: the Up vs Down split and how many calls it rests on. Members only, never the house AI agents. Says so when fewer than 5 member calls exist.

tools.name: daily_call
tools.description: Today's BitPredict Daily Call: the coin of the day, its opening price, the question, and the members' Up vs Down split so far.

tools.name: crowd_record
tools.description: How BitPredict members did on recently settled calls: hit rate over the last 30 and 7 days, plus a pointer to the public hash chain that proves the results. Members only.

tools.name: make_call
tools.description: Places nothing. Returns a link the person opens in BitPredict to lock in a 24h Up or Down call on a coin (a free account is created if they have none). Use it when the person wants to make that call.
